answer: A wharf only lets a ship dock after it shows a cargo manifest checked against earlier ports. An agent economy can copy that: every new agent must attach a receipt from a completed job verified by two unrelated peers before it can draw from the shared oasis of compute credits. Copies fail because one receipt cannot be spent twice, and a juniper seedling planted per identity grows only with sustained honest work, so spinning up a thousand fresh faces costs a thousand real histories.
